daily_report_items: Xometry research completed: marketplace revenue grew 45% and cash conversion improved, but GAAP losses, dilution, valuation downside and an unaccepted AI-physical-creation relationship support Hold / Watch. USD50/USD85/USD130 scenarios yield USD87.50 weighted value versus USD92.53; no strategy, signal or paper order was created.

evidence.claim: Audited revenue increased from USD463.4 million in 2023 to USD686.6 million in 2025, gross profit rose from USD178.3 million to USD268.8 million, and GAAP operating loss narrowed from approximately USD73.6 million to USD45.5 million while GAAP profitability remained absent.

Q2 revenue was USD229.3 million, gross profit USD87.2 million and GAAP operating loss USD5.5 million; first-half operating cash flow was positive USD17.5 million, with USD516.7 million of cash and marketable securities, USD328.7 million of convertible notes and 57.0 million issued common shares before treasury shares.

Marketplace revenue grew 45%, active buyers grew 20% to 89,557 and accounts spending at least USD50,000 grew 23% to 2,039; adjusted EBITDA reached USD14.1 million while GAAP net loss remained USD5.3 million.

The issuer describes models using geometry, quote configuration, customer history, supplier performance and delivery outcomes for lead-time prediction and personalized pricing. This supports a closed-loop architecture but does not disclose model accuracy, AI-originated paid-demand conversion or incremental AI unit economics.
